title: AI 2000s Anime Art Style Generator
summary: Make 2000s anime art style videos with AI. Describe a scene, add the early digital look, and Flick makes the clip. See 8 scenes with their prompts.
body_markdown:
### What is the 2000s anime art style?


The 2000s anime art style is the look of TV anime made as studios moved from painted cels to digital colouring. It is known for sharp, angular line art, hard cel shading, slightly desaturated colour and a soft glow on the highlights.


### How is 2000s anime different from older cel anime?


Earlier anime was mostly painted on cels, which gives warmer colour, grain and softer edges. 2000s anime was coloured digitally, so its lines and shading are cleaner and its colour is flatter, often with a digital glow added.


### Can I make 2000s anime art for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. Every scene on this page used GPT Image 2.5 and MiniMax H3 Fast, which both run on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### How do I keep the same 2000s anime look across shots?


Write one style line and end every prompt with it, word for word. Keep each character described the same way too, or make a character sheet and cite it in every shot.


### Can I turn a photo into the 2000s anime style?


Yes. Upload the photo to a Flick canvas, use it as a reference and add the style line, describing the person by hair and clothes so the model keeps them recognisable.
